title: Numeric missing, comparisons, SUM versus addition
Character missing and trailing versus leading blanks
Nullable ASC/DESC, ties and FIRST
Many-to-one MERGE with missing composite BY keys
Many-to-many MERGE retains exhausted side; IN= is group state
MERGE common variable overwritten by later observations
SUM statement reset at FIRST and explicit row order
Conditional LAG queue, including a missing queued value
WHERE before assignments; sequential IFs see updated values
Macro argument, leap day, INTNX DATEPART and grouped missing values
PUT Z5 and DATA step LENGTH truncation

source: data mart.e13_positive mart.e13_other; set source.events; if x>0 then output mart.e13_positive; else output mart.e13_other; run;

title: ARRAY + SUM + N + NMISS with all missing
source: data mart.e14_result(keep=id total present absent); set source.events; array a[3] x y z; total=sum(of a[*]); present=n(of a[*]); absent=nmiss(of a[*]); run;

title: PROC FORMAT and PUT, including ordinary numeric missing
source: proc format; value bands .='missing' low-<0='negative' 0='zero' 0<-high='positive'; run; data mart.e15_result(keep=id bucket); length bucket $8; set source.events; bucket=put(x,bands.); run;

title: PROC SQL GROUP BY, HAVING, COUNT DISTINCT, AVG and missing
source: proc sql; create table mart.e16_result as select g,count(*) as n,count(x) as present,count(distinct x) as distinct_x,sum(x) as total,avg(x) as average from source.events group by g having count(*)>=1; quit;

title: PROC SUMMARY NWAY MISSING and multiple statistics
source: proc summary data=source.events nway missing; class g; var x; output out=mart.e17_result(drop=_type_ _freq_) sum=total mean=average n=present; run;

title: INPUT COMMA informat and suppressed invalid conversion
source: data mart.e18_result(keep=id amount); set source.events; amount=input(code,?? comma12.2); run;

title: Macro DO unrolling and concatenation of every intermediate table
source: %macro build; %do i=1 %to 3; data work.t&i.; set source.events; value=x*&i.; keep id value; run; %end; data mart.e19_result; set work.t1 work.t2 work.t3; run; %mend; %build;

title: DATA then APPEND FORCE with a missing source column
source: data mart.e20_result; set source.firsts; run; proc append base=mart.e20_result data=source.seconds force; run;

title: Date arithmetic across leap days and month ends
source: data mart.e21_result(keep=id month_end next_end months); set source.events; month_end=intnx('month',d,0,'e'); next_end=intnx('month',d,1,'e'); months=intck('month','01JAN2024'd,d); format month_end next_end yymmdd10.; run;

title: CATX skips blanks and preserves nonblank tabs/NBSP
source: data mart.e22_result(keep=id joined upper_code); length joined $90 upper_code $40; set source.events; joined=catx('|',a,b); upper_code=upcase(a); run;

title: SELECT INTO computed parameter and macro IF with empty alternate
source: %macro select_positive; proc sql noprint; select count(*) into :n from source.events where x>0; quit; %if &n>0 %then %do; data mart.e23_result; set source.events; if x>0; run; %end; %else %do; data mart.e23_result; set source.events(obs=0); run; %end; %mend; %select_positive;

title: Unbounded TRANSPOSE ID domain requires an output-domain contract
source: proc transpose data=source.events out=mart.n03_result; by g; id category; var x; run;

title: Unknown environment value may not be guessed
source: %let cutoff=%sysget(MISSING_SYNTHETIC_INPUT); data mart.n04_result; set source.events; if x>&cutoff.; run;

title: Whole multi-program sales ETL: macro, DQ routes, JOIN, date aggregation and flags

sources.A: %let floor=0; %macro clean; data work.cleaned work.rejected; set source.sales; if missing(customer_id) or missing(amount) or amount<&floor then output work.rejected; else output work.cleaned; run; %mend; %clean;
sources.B: proc sql; create table work.enriched as select a.id,a.customer_id,a.g,a.observed_at,a.amount,b.segment from work.cleaned a left join source.customers b on a.customer_id=b.customer_id; quit;
sources.C: %macro aggregate; proc sql; create table mart.flow_monthly as select intnx('month',datepart(observed_at),0,'b') as month format=yymmdd10.,segment,count(*) as n,sum(amount) as total from work.enriched group by calculated month,segment; quit; %mend; %aggregate;
sources.D: data mart.flow_flags; set work.enriched; if amount>=100 then band='high'; else band='low'; keep id customer_id segment band; run;
